articles.title: RBI Could Raise Repo Rate by 75–100 bps This Cycle, SBI Capital Says
articles.excerpt: SBI Capital Markets expects the repo rate to climb further from 5.5% as inflation persists, with a possible larger hike at the December MPC review depending on September and October price data.
articles.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India headquarters in Mumbai. SBI Capital says the RBI could raise the repo rate by 75-100 bps this cycle.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs holding floating-rate home loans in India face higher EMIs as the tightening cycle runs; surplus savings in NRE/NRO fixed deposits should earn better rates.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: US Lifts Russian Diesel Sanctions Until April 2027 in Trump-Putin Deal
articles.excerpt: Trump announced phased Russian diesel deliveries after a call with Putin; the Treasury authorized Russian-origin diesel transactions through April 7, 2027, weeks before the midterms.
articles.image_caption: A roadside diesel price sign in the US displays $8.289 per gallon as a tanker truck passes on a highway. Washington has temporarily lifted sanctions on Russian diesel sales through April 2027 under a deal announced by President Trump.
articles.nri_angle: Indian refiners — major exporters of diesel and big buyers of Russian crude — could see export margins squeezed if sanctioned-lifted Russian diesel floods global markets.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Adani Green H1: Capacity Up 24% to 20,763 MW, Energy Sales Jump 32%
articles.excerpt: The renewables major added 4,083 MW of greenfield capacity and commissioned 3,081 MWh of battery storage at Khavda; the board meets October 21 to approve Q2 results.
articles.image_caption: An aerial view shows rows of solar panels at a large solar farm. Adani Green Energy reported operational capacity of 20,763 MW for the first half, up 24% from a year earlier.
articles.nri_angle: Adani stocks are widely held by diaspora investors tracking India's renewable-energy story; the October 21 results are the next checkpoint on that thesis.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: GST Council Axes Arrest Powers, Halves Penalties in Sweeping Compliance Overhaul
articles.excerpt: The 57th Council meeting recommended removing GST officers' arrest powers, raising the prosecution threshold to ₹5 crore, and automating refunds and registrations — with no rate changes on the table.
articles.image_caption: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman addresses a media briefing after the 57th GST Council meeting at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, on October 8, 2026. The Council recommended removing GST officers’ arrest powers and halving the general penalty.
articles.nri_angle: For NRIs running India operations or investing in Indian SMEs, the compliance overhaul lowers one of the biggest frictions of doing business in India — arbitrary enforcement risk — which is exactly the kind of structural change that moves the needle on India's ease-of-doing-business story.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.event: Target implementation date for new recommendations.

articles.title: Sensex Surges 879 Points as IT Stocks Lead Broad-Based Market Rebound
articles.excerpt: The Sensex and Nifty each gained more than 1% on Friday, led by a 3% IT rally on strong TCS results — but persistent FII selling and Monday's CPI print will decide if the bounce holds.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building is shown with rising market arrows. The Sensex gained 879.09 points on October 9, 2026 to close at 72,472.33, while the Nifty 50 rose 1.30% to 22,520.45.
articles.nri_angle: For NRI investors with Indian equity exposure, Friday's bounce cut the week's earlier damage — but with FIIs still selling and the RBI's tightening cycle underway, the recovery hinges on Q2 earnings delivery rather than one day's short covering.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Nifty 50 Profits Seen Growing 20% as Earnings Accelerate Despite Market Slump
articles.excerpt: Five brokerages expect Nifty 50 net profit to rise about 20% in the September quarter, building on a 10-quarter high — even as record foreign selling pushes the index toward its worst year in 15.
articles.image_caption: A trader monitors stock prices on a screen at a brokerage in Mumbai. Brokerages forecast Nifty 50 net profit growth of about 20% for the September quarter, even as foreign investors sell Indian equities at a record pace.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora investors with India mutual fund, ETF or direct equity exposure face a split: record foreign selling has crushed the Nifty while corporate profits accelerate — earnings season will show whether fundamentals reassert themselves.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Is Indian Manufacturing's Moment Finally Here? The Data Is Mixed
articles.excerpt: The Economist says Indian industry is having its moment — but factory surveys, PLI payout data, and value-addition figures paint a more complicated picture.
articles.image_caption: The Bokaro Steel Plant in Jharkhand. India's manufacturing PMI rose to 55.1 in September, a seven-month high — though steel, batteries, solar and textiles lag behind electronics assembly.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs investing in India need a clear-eyed read: manufacturing's gains are concentrated in electronics, pharma and food processing, while batteries, solar and textiles lag — pick exposure by sector, not by theme.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Fed's Waller Signals More Rate Hikes as 10-Year Yield Nears 24-Year High
articles.excerpt: The Fed governor left the door open for a pause at the October 27-28 meeting, but warned inflation remains more than a point above target as oil prices surge past $104.
articles.image_caption: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller signaled Thursday that additional interest-rate hikes will likely be needed to bring inflation back to the Fed's 2% target.
articles.nri_angle: Higher U.S. yields strengthen the dollar against the rupee, raise borrowing costs, and pull foreign capital away from Indian markets — all directly affecting NRI investors and remittance senders.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.text: Inflation is above Fed's 2% target by over 1%.
Weekly jobless claims at 197,000, below forecast of 200,000.

articles.title: TCS Beats Street Estimates as Q2 Profit Rises 15% to ₹13,884 Crore
articles.excerpt: India's largest software exporter reported ₹73,188 crore in revenue, declared a ₹12 interim dividend, and crossed a $3 billion annualised AI revenue run-rate on two landmark transformation deals with Porsche and Best Buy.
articles.image_caption: A Tata Consultancy Services campus in Electronic City. TCS reported Q2 profit of Rs 13,884 crore, beating street estimates.
articles.nri_angle: TCS is the anchor blue-chip for many diaspora investors in Indian equities; its 15% profit beat, ₹12 dividend with an October 14 record date, and $9.6 billion deal pipeline signal stability in Indian IT during a volatile market week.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.text: Annualised AI revenue reached $3.1 billion
2,176 AI-led inventions filed
649 AI-led inventions granted

articles.title: Sensex Tanks 900 Points, Nifty Slides Below 22,300 as RBI Hike Selloff Deepens
articles.excerpt: Indian benchmarks extended their fall in midday trade on Thursday, October 8, a day after the RBI raised the repo rate to 5.50% and shifted its stance to 'calibrated tightening.' IT heavyweights TCS, Infosys and HCLTech bucked the selloff ahead of TCS's quarterly results.
articles.image_caption: A red downward-trending arrow over a grid of falling bar charts and negative percentage figures. The Sensex and Nifty 50 both fell more than 1% in midday trade on Thursday, October 8, after the RBI's repo rate hike.
articles.nri_angle: A near-record-low rupee means remitted dollars buy more rupees, but sustained FII selling and a rising-rate cycle are headwinds for NRI portfolios with Indian equity exposure.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Asia Stocks Fall as Oil Surge, Rising Yields Weigh; Samsung Slips on Record Profit
articles.excerpt: MSCI's Asia-Pacific index fell 0.3% on Thursday as Brent crude topped $104 a barrel on U.S.-Iran escalation fears and 10-year Treasury yields neared multi-decade highs. Samsung Electronics slid despite a record $80 billion quarterly profit after the result fell short of some analyst estimates.
articles.image_caption: The market centre at the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Asian stocks fell as surging oil prices and rising bond yields weighed on markets.
articles.nri_angle: Surging oil prices and rising U.S. yields are direct headwinds for India as a major oil importer, pressuring the rupee, fuel prices and foreign investor flows into Indian equities.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.text: Operating profit: 107.4 trillion won ($80 billion)
Profit increase: 783% from last year
Revenue: 195 trillion won ($145 billion)
Operating margin: 55% (highest ever)

articles.title: Foreign Investors Pulled ₹21,745 Crore From Indian Stocks in Late September
articles.excerpt: Foreign portfolio investors sold ₹21,745 crore ($2.3 billion) of Indian equities in the second half of September, intensifying a selloff led by financials, oil & gas, and auto stocks as rising US yields and crude prices drove a global allocation reset.
articles.image_caption: A candlestick stock chart illustrating the September 2026 wave of foreign outflows from Indian equities. FPIs withdrew roughly Rs 35,860 crore from Indian stocks during the month.
articles.nri_angle: For NRIs with Indian equity exposure, the selloff is a global-allocation rotation rather than an India-specific verdict — and with domestic institutions absorbing more than foreigners sold, SIP flows and large-cap entry points look healthier than the outflow headlines suggest.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Fed Minutes Signal Another Rate Hike by Year-End as Officials Split on Why
articles.excerpt: Minutes from the Fed's September meeting show all 19 policymakers backed the quarter-point increase to 3.75%-4%, with most expecting one more hike this year — but sharply divided over the reason for tightening.
articles.image_caption: The Marriner S. Eccles Federal Reserve Board Building in Washington, DC. Minutes from the Fed's September meeting signal another rate hike by year-end.
articles.nri_angle: Higher US borrowing costs directly shape dollar-denominated household budgets — mortgages, auto and credit-card debt, and savings yields — for the diaspora's US-based readers.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Americans' One-Year Inflation Expectations Hit 3.9%, Highest Since May 2023
articles.excerpt: The New York Fed's September Survey of Consumer Expectations shows households bracing for faster price growth across gas, food, rent, medical care and college costs — keeping the central bank on track for another rate hike before year end.
articles.image_caption: The Marriner S. Eccles Federal Reserve Board Building in Washington, DC. The New York Fed's Survey of Consumer Expectations showed one-year inflation expectations rising to 3.9%, the highest since May 2023.
articles.nri_angle: For the diaspora, higher-for-longer US rates keep mortgage and loan costs elevated while supporting the dollar — a direct factor in remittance value and NRI portfolio returns.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: RBI Hikes Repo Rate to 5.50% in First Increase in Nearly Four Years
articles.excerpt: The six-member MPC voted unanimously to raise rates and shifted its stance to "calibrated tightening" as inflation climbs to 4.8%.
articles.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India tower in Mumbai. The RBI's Monetary Policy Committee raised the repo rate to 5.50% on October 7, 2026, its first hike in nearly four years.
articles.nri_angle: A firmer rate differential should support the rupee against a strong dollar, which matters for remittance timing; meanwhile NRIs with Indian home loans will see EMIs edge up, while NRI deposit and FCNR returns should improve as banks pass through higher rates.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Gold Coils Below $4,150 as Markets Await the Fed's Minutes
articles.excerpt: Bullion slipped as the dollar and Treasury yields climbed, with traders pricing an 85% chance of a December rate hike ahead of the September FOMC minutes.
articles.image_caption: A dollar symbol rests on a golden weighing pan. Gold eased to $4,150 an ounce on Wednesday as a stronger dollar and rising Treasury yields pressured the metal ahead of the Federal Reserve meeting minutes.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian investors, the global pullback contrasts with strong domestic festive-season demand — with 24-karat gold around Rs 1.49 lakh per 10 grams in India, how much of that demand offsets macro headwinds will shape the metal's next move.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Nvidia Nears $6 Trillion on Record Highs and Biggest Buyback Ever
articles.excerpt: Shares hit a record $239.11 as the AI chipmaker closes in on the first-ever $6 trillion market cap, powered by a $150 billion buyback and a $108 billion revenue outlook.
articles.image_caption: Nvidia headquarters in Santa Clara, California. The AI chipmaker closed at a record high this week, pushing its market value toward $5.8 trillion.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora investors with US retirement accounts, Nvidia's roughly 7–8% weight in the S&P 500 means its swings land directly in index portfolios, whether or not they hold the stock itself.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian Banks Face a Q2 Paradox: FCNR Flood Boosts Loans, Squeezes Margins
articles.excerpt: Brokerages expect Q2FY27 bank earnings to rise about 11%, powered by 18.8% credit growth and $127 billion of FCNR deposits — but the foreign-currency funding is set to shave 8–20 basis points off net interest margins.
articles.image_caption: An HDFC Bank branch in India, with a pedestrian walking past the entrance. HDFC Bank grew deposits 19% year-on-year in Q2FY27, outpacing its loan growth of over 15%.
articles.nri_angle: The $127 billion came from NRI pockets, and FCNR(B) deposits' foreign-currency denomination keeps depositors' returns free of rupee risk — though rates on fresh deposits are likely to soften as banks deploy the liquidity.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Adani Power Rises 2% After Signing 770-MW Bhutan Hydropower Deal With DGPC
articles.excerpt: The 49:51 joint venture with Bhutan's DGPC will develop the Chamkharchhu-I project on a 30-year BOOT concession, with construction starting in early 2027.
articles.image_caption: The Adani logo appears behind electricity transmission towers in this file photo. Adani Power signed a shareholders’ agreement with Bhutan’s DGPC to develop the 770-MW Chamkharchhu-I hydropower project under a 49:51 partnership.
articles.nri_angle: The project deepens India-Bhutan energy ties with surplus summer power flowing to India's grid, and extends Adani Power's contracted clean-energy pipeline — relevant for diaspora investors tracking Indian utility stocks, though cash flows are a decade away.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: World Bank Raises India's FY27 Growth Forecast to 7.1%, Flags AI as Next Driver
articles.excerpt: The multilateral lender lifted its 2026/27 estimate by 50 basis points on resilient domestic demand, while warning that oil prices, El Niño and market volatility threaten the outlook.
articles.image_caption: The World Bank Group logo displayed on a wall at the institution’s headquarters. The Bank on Tuesday raised India’s 2026/27 GDP growth forecast to 7.1% from 6.6%, citing resilient domestic demand and strong remittances.
articles.nri_angle: The RBI is expected to raise rates on Oct 7 for the first time since 2023, which would lift NRE/NRO deposit yields for NRIs while raising borrowing costs in India; the World Bank also credits strong diaspora remittances as a pillar of India's resilient domestic demand.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.text: Inflation expected to average 5% in FY27.
Higher inflation erodes consumer purchasing power.
18-month lag expected between shocks and output effects.

articles.title: Japanese Companies Exit China in Record Numbers as India Emerges as Alternative
articles.excerpt: Teikoku Databank counts 10,118 Japanese companies in mainland China, down 30% from the 2012 peak, as firms shift investment toward India and Southeast Asia.
articles.image_caption: The national flags of China and Japan appear side by side. Japanese companies have cut their presence in China to the lowest level since 2010, with 10,118 firms operating there as of June 2026, according to Teikoku Databank.
articles.nri_angle: The pivot benefits India directly: Japanese manufacturers shifting capacity to India feed order books for industrial parks, logistics and suppliers — a concrete demand tailwind for India-focused investment portfolios.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.text: Share of profits from China fell to below 15%
Share from the U.S. rose to 35% from 25%

articles.title: Schneider Electric to Buy PTC for $22.6 Billion in Its Biggest Deal Ever
articles.excerpt: The $205-a-share all-cash offer, a 42.3% premium, sent PTC shares up nearly 34% on Monday. Schneider's stock fell about 10% in Paris as investors weighed the price and the up-to-EUR-23-billion financing plan.
articles.image_caption: Schneider Electric’s headquarters. The French engineering group agreed to acquire US industrial software company PTC for $22.6 billion in cash.
articles.nri_angle: No direct impact for most readers, but the deal is another major bet on data-centre and industrial-AI infrastructure, a sector employing a large Indian tech workforce in the US and Europe.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: HDFC Bank Taps ICICI's Anup Bagchi as CEO With Stock Down 27% in 2026
articles.excerpt: RBI approved Anup Bagchi's appointment as MD and CEO for a three-year term from October 27, 2026, ending months of succession uncertainty. Jefferies reaffirmed HDFC Bank as its top Indian pick with a Rs 880 target, even as the stock sits 27% below its 2025 close.
articles.image_caption: An HDFC Bank branch. The bank has named ICICI's Anup Bagchi as its next CEO, starting October 19, 2026.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs holding HDB ADRs or Indian bank ETFs have absorbed a 27% slide in 2026; an external CEO with a retail-franchise track record offers a reset narrative, though execution risk is real.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Tops Global SIP Returns: 74% of 5-Year Periods Beat 8% Mark
articles.excerpt: DSP Asset Managers' 30-year, 16-country study found India the most rewarding market for systematic investors — though recent five-year Nifty SIP returns of ~4.5% show the average hides deep swings.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange in Mumbai. Indian SIP investors saw strong five-year returns.
articles.nri_angle: For NRIs comparing India with other markets, India's SIP edge in the DSP data is nominal — higher inflation and currency moves eat into it — while SPIVA data showing 84% of large-cap funds trailing benchmarks argues for low-cost index SIPs over active fund-picking.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: US Student Loan Defaults Hit $234 Billion — and Collections May Restart
articles.excerpt: Federal data through June 30 shows 9.3 million borrowers in default — up from 7.7 million six months earlier — as the Trump administration keeps involuntary collections paused while it stands up a new support system.
articles.image_caption: A chart of US consumer and government debt, including student loans. (Wikimedia Commons)
articles.nri_angle: Indian students and recent graduates financing US degrees through federal loans face the same garnishment and credit consequences as any borrower — and the new repayment plans launched in July matter to anyone holding F-1 OPT-era debt.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.text: Wage garnishment up to 15% of disposable pay.
Tax refunds can be seized.
Collection costs can add up to 24%.
Borrowers earning under $50,000 default at nearly three times the rate.

articles.title: Sitharaman Says India-US Trade Talks Have Hit a 'Plateau'
articles.excerpt: The finance minister said further give-and-take would be 'very, very difficult' for both sides — but negotiations continue toward an interim bilateral trade agreement.
articles.image_caption: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman at a public event. She said India-US trade talks may have reached a plateau.
articles.nri_angle: No tariff relief is imminent for NRIs with businesses tied to India-US supply chains or investments in trade-exposed sectors — duty uncertainty continues with no deadline announced.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jio IPO Likely by October-End at $143-146 Billion Valuation
articles.excerpt: Banking sources say Jio Platforms' estimated $3.8 billion public offering — potentially India's largest IPO — could list by month-end, with an anchor round before Dussehra and final SEBI filings in the week starting October 12.
articles.nri_angle: At $143-146 billion the valuation is legible to diaspora investors in global terms; NRIs with demat accounts can apply for Indian IPOs on the same terms as residents.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

data_cards.card_title: India's Largest IPO in the Making

articles.title: India Within Striking Distance of 8% Growth, Says PMO's Shaktikanta Das
articles.excerpt: The former RBI governor credited a decade of reforms — GST, banking clean-up, inflation targeting, digital payments — for 7.8% June-quarter growth, and named AI the next productivity frontier.
articles.image_caption: Shaktikanta Das, principal secretary to the prime minister and former RBI governor, at the Kautilya Economic Conclave in New Delhi
articles.nri_angle: The domestic-demand growth story underpins the NRI investment case — steady remittances, services surplus and deepening capital markets keep the macro backdrop for diaspora portfolios supportive.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Gold Fell 6% in September. Can Diwali Demand Spark a Rebound?
articles.excerpt: Surging Treasury yields and another expected Fed rate hike hammered gold in September. But cheaper prices are pulling Indian buyers back just as the festival season begins.
articles.image_caption: Three gold bars marked Fine Gold sit on a background showing a declining price chart. Spot gold fell more than 6% in September before cheaper prices drew Indian buyers back ahead of Diwali.
articles.nri_angle: Indian festival demand is one of the few bullish offsets analysts see for gold in Q4; wedding-season buying has stayed resilient while Indian investors rotate steadily into gold ETFs and digital gold.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.text: 67% increase in Indian gold ETF inflows in August.
Digital gold purchases averaged Rs 25 billion monthly.
110% year-on-year increase in digital gold purchases.

articles.title: Why Diesel Costs More Than Gasoline — and When the Flip Happened
articles.excerpt: National diesel is averaging $6.38 a gallon, nearly $2 above gasoline. Three structural reasons — demand, cleaner-fuel rules and taxes — plus the Iran war's supply shock explain the gap.
articles.image_caption: Diesel fuel pump at a gas station. Diesel averaged .38 a gallon nationally, holding above gasoline since September 2004
articles.nri_angle: India's early-2000s motorizing boom was one of the demand drivers that helped flip diesel's price against gasoline; today the $6.38 average hits US consumers broadly, including Indian-American families in trucking and logistics.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Warsh's 'Dose of Accommodation' Remark Has Wall Street Bracing for More Fed Rate Hikes
articles.excerpt: The Fed chairman's deliberate phrasing after September's rate hike — the first in three years — has traders, banks and economists debating how many more increases are coming.
articles.image_caption: Official portrait of Kevin Warsh.
articles.nri_angle: U.S.-based Indian diaspora homebuyers and borrowers face mortgage rates tied to the 10-year Treasury's 19-year high as the Fed signals more hikes.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

data_cards.card_title: Market Reactions to Fed's Rate Hike

articles.title: IT Q2 Preview: Large Caps May Cut Guidance as AI Deflation Hits 7%
articles.excerpt: ICICI Securities and Kotak expect Infosys to cut FY27 guidance to 1.5-2.5% as AI concessions bite; mid-caps like Persistent and Coforge are set to outgrow the majors again.
articles.image_caption: The glass pyramid at the Infosys campus in Mysuru (Wikimedia Commons)
articles.nri_angle: AI deflation is now a hard number reshaping India's $283B IT sector — the employer of millions of Indian tech professionals in the US and India — while mid-cap outperformers signal a structural shift in the India-to-world tech pipeline.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
